packs.title: Stories, Science and Sky
packs.promise: Explore Oklahoma City through remembrance, living cultures, art, science and distinctive public spaces.

q.s: Make room for remembrance and the meaning of this place.
st: Read the Memorial operator’s explanation of the outdoor site.
Choose a permitted comfortable position and pause quietly, leaving other visitors space.
Record a brief reflection on one stated purpose of the Memorial.

q.s: Let an artwork prompt a new relationship of color.
st: Choose an artwork and credit its maker and title.
Notice a relationship between two colors or shapes.
Create an original composition with a different subject, following gallery rules or working afterward.

q.s: Use a plant shape to begin an original design.
st: Enter with a valid conservatory ticket and stay on the visitor path.
Notice the outline of one plant without touching it.
Invent an original object or pattern based on that outline.

packs.title: Brick, Water, Small Details
packs.promise: Look closely at a district built for changing uses.

q.s: Find the small patterns in a big facade.
st: Choose a public view of brickwork without entering a business.
Find a horizontal run, a joint pattern and an opening edge.
Name the three patterns or record a detail view that avoids people and business text.

q.s: Read a street in three bands.
st: Choose a clear sidewalk position and look at a street-facing building.
Find one detail near its roof, one around eye level and one near the pavement.
Describe how the three differ without approaching entrances.

q.s: Collect the materials that frame the water.
st: Choose a comfortable public overlook or canal path without needing stairs.
Find three different surfaces around the channel, such as brick, metal, concrete or planting.
Describe the three; water and boats are not needed.
